claims.text: The latest stable Pulumi release as of the post's snapshot is v3.261.0 (2026-09-02) in the comparison table, while the license table and Pulumi section list v3.263.0 released 2026-09-16 (inconsistent versions across the post).
The latest stable Terraform release is listed as v1.16.1 (2026-09-02) in the comparison table and v1.16.3 (2026-09-16) in the license table and Terraform section.
The latest stable AWS CDK release is listed as v2.268.0 (2026-09-02) in the comparison table and v2.270.0 (2026-09-17) in the license table and CDK section.
The latest stable Azure Bicep release is v0.47.16, released 2026-09-08.
The comparison table lists Azure Bicep latest stable release as v0.46.1 (2026-07-30), inconsistent with v0.47.16 elsewhere.
The latest stable Kubernetes release is v1.37.0, released 2026-08-26.
Crossplane's latest stable release is v2.4.1 (2026-09-15) in the license table and Crossplane section, while the comparison table lists v2.4.0 (2026-08-20).
OpenTofu's latest stable release is v1.12.6, released 2026-08-19.
Version and release-date figures were checked against each project's GitHub releases on 2026-09-21.
Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.
env zero (formerly env0) prices its paid tiers per successful apply or environment.
env zero was formerly known as env0.
GitHub star counts: Pulumi ~25.7k, Terraform ~49.7k, AWS CDK ~12.9k, Azure Bicep ~3.6k, Kubernetes ~127.9k, Crossplane ~12.1k, OpenTofu ~30.2k.
As of 2026-09-21, GitHub stars: Kubernetes ~127,900, Terraform ~49,700, OpenTofu ~30,200, Pulumi ~25,700, AWS CDK ~12,900, Crossplane ~12,100; Terraform is the most-starred dedicated IaC tool.
Google Cloud Deployment Manager reached end of support on March 31, 2026, with the service fully turned down on June 30, 2027.
Google Cloud Infrastructure Manager replaces Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
Pulumi Cloud's Free edition is free forever for one user with unlimited stacks and projects and 500 workflow minutes per month.
Pulumi Cloud Essentials starts at $40/month with 40 credits included and up to 500 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Pro starts at $400/month with 400 credits included and up to 2,000 managed resources.
Pulumi Cloud Enterprise is custom, contract-priced.

HCP Terraform is free for up to 500 managed resources with one concurrent run, then per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier; Terraform Enterprise is custom priced.
Pricing figures reflect published pricing as of September 2026 (checked 2026-09-21).
